alerts.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 6 at 9:14PM EST until November 6 at 11:30PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: At 914 PM EST, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms producing heavy rain which has led to numerous road closures across Acushnet and New Bedford. Between 1.5 and 2.5 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring. HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms. SOURCE...Law enforcement…
alerts.instruction: Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles. Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the dangers of flooding. Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads. Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become unstable and unsafe. Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law…
